verdicts.reason: A: the black panel has shrunk to a tiny 'MOVIE NIGHT' chip in the bottom-left corner. All the other white copy (film title, tagline, date, venue, URL) sits in a jammed, overlapping cluster near the top, directly on the busy line-art, and none of it can be read. B: the panel is larger and the headline inside it is readable, but the box holds only empty dividers. Every other white line (tagline, date, venue, URL) is scattered at large sizes across the busy illustration and can't be read, and some lines run off the right edge. Both are unusable. B is slightly less bad because its headline survives at a sensible size.
